from: chapitres 0 et 5 de la vidéo longue (marge de 75 %, puces maison des clients)
paragraphs: Between May and July 2026, out of every dollar of Nvidia's sales, about {seventy-five cents|75 cents} was left after paying for what it cost to make them.

Now put yourself in the place of its biggest customers. Only about a quarter of what you pay Nvidia covers what the product costs to make. Build a chip that's good enough for your own needs, and you keep much of the rest.
And they are building them. Google designs its own, called TPUs. Amazon has Trainium. OpenAI is designing chips with Broadcom. And Meta's own chip is about to ship in volume.
That's the real competition. Not a rival selling the same thing. Customers deciding they'd rather make it themselves. Full story on the channel.
